However, if there is such an ATC which has no counterpart in the said policy, then the ATC shall prevail. *The supplier/manufacturer shall be responsible for carrying out repairs free of cost if any fault arises in th e machine or spare parts specified in the bid during the guarantee/warranty period. *Only quality material conforming to the specified specifications shall be supplied. Payment of the bill will be made only thereafter. If the material/equipment is found to be of inadequate or non-conforming quality, the supplier shall be required to take back the material/equipment from the institution at their own expens e and provide replaced good quality product to institution. *After receipt of a work order from this Institute, it is mandatory to supply all items s pecified in the work order. If all items specified in the work order are not supplied by your party, In that case, this organization shall have the authority to cancel the entir e work order. Furthermore, an incident will be raised against your party on the GeM p ortal. *All items supplied as per the Work Order must be of good quality and in accordance with the prescribed s pecifications. All the items to be supplied by the firm shall either comply with BIS/ISI Standards. For any ite ms do not comply BIS/ISI Standards, the Quality shall be determined by the Institute, whose decision in the Quality matter of such items shall be final and binding. * Turnover of the bidder The minimum average annual financial turnover or actual production of the bidder/ during the last th ree years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be at least twice (Rs.163200/-) the bid value of Rs.81600/-. (Bid Estimated value mentioned in bid document) Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate fr om the Chartered Accountant/ Cost Accountant indicating the financial turnover or actual production detail s for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of t he bidder is less than 3 year old, the average financial turnover or actual production in respect of the comp leted financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. * The warranty provided by the bidder must be on site at consignee place. * Consider All Item Warranty as Warranty Mention in Specification Document *For any dispute decision of head of the Institute, PRINCIPAL ITI JESAR will be final.

* The area of jurisdiction shall be JESAR. . 13. Warranty Timely Servicing / rectification of defects during warranty period: After having been notified of the defects / service requirement during warranty period, Seller has to complete the required Service / Rectification within 15 days time limit. If the Seller fails to complete service / rectification with defined time limit, a penalty of 0.5% of Unit Price of the product shall be charged as penalty for each week of delay from the seller. Seller can deposit the penalty with the Buyer directly else the Buyer shall have a right to recover all such penalty amount from the Performance Security (PBG).Cumulative Penalty cannot exceed more than 10% of the total contract value after which the Buyer shall have the right to get the service / rectification done from alternate sources at the risk and cost of the Seller besides forfeiture of PBG. Seller shall be liable to re-imberse the cost of such service / rectification to the Buyer.
